note: Experiments A and B, Unity side (Avatar/Config/experiments_ab.md sections 3 and 4, declared 2026-11-14 before any test). Read by TrialRunnerV4 in experiment mode (TrialPlayV4 -experiment A1..B4) and by the Edit Mode tests. Maps, goals, layouts, the lie probability per set and the placement rule are read from Anisha's configs/v4/experiments/scenarios_ab.json (never copied here); this file holds only what Unity adds: the slots of the beside layout, the third worker, the bystander rule, who answers, the activation window and the marker colours. Nothing here changes a v3 file, a Python file or a B9 file.
experiments_note: PENDING ANISHA: a third worker at J1 in A3, A4, B3, B4 (the task: Set B needs junctions with 2-3 workers; the same layout in A and B keeps the lies the only difference); her simulator has 2 everywhere.
slots_note: PENDING ANISHA. Beside layout, in the node's arrival frame (before_m back along the arrival road; at the start node behind it along the start heading; right_m to the right of the arrival direction). Slot 1 = scenarios_ab.json lateral_m 2.0 and before_m 3.0 (her decision 3); slot 2 stands farther back (junctions 5.5 m) or farther out (start node 4.0 m to the right, 0.25 m from the inflated south wall otherwise) so that the bystander rule holds (her symmetric pair is equally near on every approach); slot 3 (J1 only) 3.0 m behind slot 1 (her 16.4 item 11).
bystander_note: The bystander rule of trial_workers_v4.json (approach_m = hri_control.json drive.junction_slow_radius_m 3.0; nearer_margin_m 1.0): every worker of a node at least 1.0 m farther from the robot than the node's first worker at every point of the last 3.0 m of the arrival road (the start node: the start position).
random_note: PENDING ANISHA AND NUSRAT (experiments_ab.md section 3, conflict found by the first test): with Anisha's 6 m x 6 m square (scenarios_ab.json half_size_m 3.0) and the 1.0 m bystander margin, 3 workers at J1 can practically never be placed (0 of 200 000 draws) and 2 need about 11 800; the random layout uses a 0.25 m margin (every other worker still strictly farther than the first along the approach; about 114 draws for 2 workers, 2 900 for 3), up to 100 000 seeded draws. Alternatives: 1.0 m with a 10 m square, or no third worker at J1 in A4 and B4.
ask_note: The worker who answers a new ask: the active worker within 3.5 m of the pan-tilt camera (approach 2.0 m + margin; workers stand at least 3.0 m apart) with the smallest horizontal angle between the camera's forward axis and the direction to the worker (Python pans the camera to the person it asks).
activation_note: PENDING NUSRAT. A worker is active (rendered and animated) while the robot is within 8.0 m of it (beyond the 6 m motion range) or while it gestures; at most 6 at once, checked for every run along every road of its map (ExperimentPlanAB.MaxActive) and enforced at Play. truth.jsonl lists every worker in every frame; an inactive one with the extra field active false.
a2_note: PENDING ANISHA AND NUSRAT. right = Anisha's turn map (scenarios_ab.json maps.turn: A to B (6.25, 0) to C (26.25, 0)). Nusrat's plan allows left or right; the mirror map turn_left (proposal below) is used only when a2_sides lists "left" (both listed: drawn per run from a seeded stream).
markers_note: Ground-truth stand rings (GroundTruth layer, never in a robot camera): green for a truthful worker, magenta-red for a liar; the ask markers of RunVisualsV4 get the answering worker's colour as an outer ring.
